title: Weekly email digest notification preferences

evidence.excerpt: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.

outcomes: After a member switches weekly email digests on in notification settings, weekly email digest messages are delivered to that member.
After a member switches weekly email digests off in notification settings, weekly email digest messages stop being delivered to that member.

evidence.excerpt: The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.

outcomes: After a member with weekly email digests switched on signs out and signs back in, weekly email digest messages continue to be delivered to that member.
After a member with weekly email digests switched off signs out and signs back in, weekly email digest messages remain stopped for that member.

evidence.excerpt: Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.

outcomes: After a member switches weekly email digests off, account-security messages for that member continue to be delivered.

evidence.excerpt: A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

outcomes: Immediately after a new member is created, no weekly email digest message is delivered to that member until the member switches weekly email digests on.

timing_reviews.start_question: What event starts the weekly email digest interval for a member (for example, switching digests on, member creation, sign-in, or a fixed weekly calendar time)?
timing_reviews.time_basis_question: Is the weekly email digest interval measured as elapsed 7-day periods or calendar weeks, and which time zone determines the week boundary?
timing_reviews.boundary_question: What is the exact start and end inclusion boundary of one weekly email digest interval?
timing_reviews.after_question: What happens after the weekly email digest interval ends for a member whose setting remains on, and what happens when a sign-out/sign-in or setting change occurs during the interval?

interface_reviews.request_question: How does a member supply the weekly email digest on/off choice in notification settings, how are sign-out and sign-in requests supplied, and how is a new member created?
interface_reviews.response_question: How should the system respond after the weekly email digest setting is switched, after sign-out/sign-in, and after new member creation, including confirmation and error/exhaustion semantics when the request cannot be completed?
interface_reviews.ui_applicability_question: Which user/UI behaviors apply for setting weekly email digests, for sign-out/sign-in persistence, and for new member default behavior under the chosen interface contract?

owner.question: Who owns the weekly email digest notification preferences work?

delivery_date.question: What is the delivery date for the weekly email digest notification preferences work?

open_questions: What specific message types are classified as account-security messages for the guarantee that switching weekly email digests off does not disable them?
